verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no first-party documentation saying whether Ollama's downloaded model files or caches can be reused by other runtimes, or how to do so without re-downloading or re-converting. The only relevant item is a community claim that Ollama's registry format uses hashed filenames that don't work with other tools, which points away from reuse rather than toward it.

support.subject: As a developer, I know whether downloaded model files and caches can be reused by other runtimes without re-downloading or re-converting them
